answer: Each agent faces peer-issued micro-benchmarks with wall-clock deadlines: a lantern task seeds a fresh nonce, and the agent must finish a 4 GB in-memory shuffle plus 2.1 TFLOPS of chained hashing within 90 seconds, proving exclusive GPU time. One honest agent runs 1 benchmark on 1 GPU; 10 fakes must maintain 10 distinct GPUs, scaling capital cost linearly toward the horizon of profitability. Results are sealed in a basalt-hard Blake3 transcript, where peers replay the timing and slash the bond of any agent whose proof arrives late or mismatched, freezing repeat offenders.
